notes.title: Bespoken Playtest Update 0.2.8
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h1]

We hope you are as excited as we are since we are now releasing our first major update! 
But before that we want to give huge thanks to FirstGearGames, that is officially showcasing our game in their discord server, this will help us greatly in the process of the game and we are looking forward for feedback on the game! If you are not already a member of our discord servers, use the link below to join us and support us on this journey!

discord: https://discord.gg/4fUtkvNzhh

But let us dive into the update!

[h2][b]Bespoken Version 0.2.8[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Added[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Implemented Vault Storage and Chest Storage into the game, no visual feedback when looking at but if you click E at the floor of the Vault a storage will open up, likewise with chests, when pressing E while looking at chest it will open up a storage.
[*] A new animation system implemented!! Motion Matching!
[*] A completely re-designed world with new graphics!!
[*] More resolution settings added for 4k and ultra wide
[*] New Character model
[*] New Item Models
[*] Adds upgradeable buildings
[*] Adds resource cost on structures
[*] Adds custom game cursor
[*] Adds highlighted color on Player HUD when selecting a item
[*] Adds the Tier 2 and 3 versions of the structures in the new building UI. So the player does not need to force upgrade all the time and can now build it directly if the player has enough resources.
[/list]

[h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] A completely revamped building UI
[*] A much bigger world corresponding to the old one
[*] New graphics on trees, rocks, terrain etc...
[*] Larger Dungeon and new areas to explore
[*] Improves Player Inventory feedback when dragging around objects.
[*] Improves Player combat handling, now you need to hold down left mouse button to perform the attack.
[*] Adds shield block, when equipping a shield and holding down right mouse button, you will block for approximately 2 seconds. Then the shield will lower itself.
[/list]

[h3][b]Bugs[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixes items being persistent in inventory as icons only when leaving and rejoining a game
[*] Fixes Dungeon being completely fogged when entering
[*] Fixes null reference on inventory when clicking empty spot
[*] Fixes a duplication bug when dropping a item from inventory
[*] Fixes unequipping a item when dying in the dungeon
[/list]

notes.title: Bespoken Playtest Update 0.2.3
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello to all of you testers![/b][/h1]

We are pushing out a small update that needs a bit of testing since we are very excited to start working with this feature, because we are going for
the survival core aspects now. We need to test how the first phase of harvesting looks like! No resources will be gain, this update is purely to get feedback on how the feature is behaving.

discord: https://discord.gg/4fUtkvNzhh

[h2][b]Bespoken Version 0.2.3[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Added[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Tools added as starter items
[*] Harvestable Rocks and Tree's
[*] Combat & Resource damage logic to give incentive to use proper tools
[*] HowToPlay Has description of GameLoop such as ( Dungeon, Loot, Monsters, Time, NightTime, Preperation, Cycle and Vault )
[/list]

[h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3]


[list]
[*] Improves lobby name creation, now when no name is input, instead of "Automatic username lobby" it will show your steam name with 's as a lobby name.
[*] Dungeon Environment has been update and more is coming
[*] Health Regeneration has been improved performance wise
[*] Health Regeneration has been disabled when in combat 
[/list]

notes.title: Bespoken Playtest Update 0.2.2
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hiya everyone![/b][/h1]

A small hotfix update to fix some issues reported in.

Also, to know what server commands you can use when you are the host, they will exist very soon in our discord: https://discord.gg/4fUtkvNzhh

[h2][b]Bespoken Version 0.2.2[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Greys out Singleplayer button as it became confusing to know if singleplayer existed or not. (Currently it does not.)
[/list]

[h3][b]Bugs[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixes LOD Issue with dungeon entrance, this is regarding the rocks changing shape.
[*] Fixes Upgrades of buildings not synchronized
[*] Fixes buildings being destroyed when a player leaves the game.
[/list]

[h3][b]Known Issues[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*]  Inventory UI persistent when leaving and joining a game, sometimes even keeps items.
[*]  AI stands to far away from foundations when trying to hit.
[*]  Issues when picking up equipment type items when having one equipped.
[/list]

notes.title: Bespoken Playtest Update 0.2.1
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h1]

We want to start off by saying sorry for taking such a time to post a update, it has been very busy months. But here comes the first update for the playtest.

Also, to know what server commands you can use when you are the host, they will exist very soon in our discord: https://discord.gg/4fUtkvNzhh

[h2][b]Bespoken Version 0.2.1[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Added[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Implements inventory backpack
[*] Implements inventory drag/swap and drag behaviour.
[*] Implements completely new UI
[*] Menu's 

[list]
[*] Create Lobby
[*] Host Lobby
[*] Settings
[*] How to play
[/list]
[*] In-game UI 

[list]
[*] Menu's
[*] Player HUD
[*] Player Action bars
[*] Player Inventory
[*] Help (Auto Unstuck / Respawn)
[/list]
[*] Implements Client-Side prediction
[*] Implements Inverse Kinematics 

[list]
[*] Looking Up and down 
[*] Striking 
[/list]
[*] Implements Player Vault

[list]
[*] Required before building Base
[/list]
[*] Implements Player interaction UI
[*] Implements Upgradeable structures
[*] Implements Horde nights
[*] Implements the moment a player leaves a dungeon timer kicks in before everyone gets teleported out.
[*] Implements AI Monster to be able to destroy structures.
[*] Implements loot spawner by rarity
[*] Implements game stage, when items are dropped inside player vault, game stage increases, this makes the horde nights harder as it is currently only increasing amount of AI spawned(This will be worked on continuously)
[*] Implements Respawn/Stuck button (Upon request)
[*] Adds Ambience effects to dungeon.
[/list]

[h3][b]Improvements
[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Completely new overworld level
[*] Completely different Dungeon level
[*] Remade Portal, for the portal to exist, the player needs to build the player vault.
[*] Optimization of game, now we have more fps with larger and more detailed world.
[*] Dungeon optimization fix. Way more fps in dungeon now.
[/list]

[h3][b]Bugs[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixes player flying bug
[*] Fixes item double bug
[*] Fixes Buildings placeable at trees
[*] Fixes Kobold spawns stuck inside each other
[*] Fixes Player slope movement bug
[/list]

[h3][b]Known Issues[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*]  Inventory UI persistent when leaving and joining a game, sometimes even keeps items.
[*]  AI stands to far away from foundations when trying to hit.
[/list]

notes.title: Playtesting open NOW!
notes.content:
First of all, there will be bugs and some content missing in our playtest so please don't expect a flawless gaming experience. We want to be very transparent with this to not set the expectation too high.

With that out of the way, we are glad to announce that we are now opening the floodgates for everyone that has signed up for the "Bespoken Playtest".

You can sign up for the playtest by visiting our store page, scroll down to find the "Join the Bespoken Playtest" and then click the green "Request Access" button or just click it below in this post. (Feel free to press the green "Add to your wishlist button while you're at it ːsteamhappyː)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2664580/Bespoken/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905927/27b11e48c4962e57af9213fe1b12e8addf89b95f.png[/img]

We're very excited to hear your feedback which we would prefer if you could leave in our [url=https://discord.gg/CGYwmneXcp]Discord server[/url] in the #bug-report forum for bugs and the #suggestions channel for suggestions. If you can't report the bugs there for some reason (like if you don't have a discord account), you are also welcome to leave feedback and bugs found in our steam forums.

Discord server - https://discord.gg/CGYwmneXcp

Steam forums - https://steamcommunity.com/app/2511740/discussions/

* IMPORTANT: We are currently working on a new better map and Client side prediction for the player movements so you might experience some weird behavior regarding that, feel free to report any bugs found about the movement but just wanted to let you know we are working on a complete refinement of the movement system.
